title: Research notes: sourced claims for one wine, one vintage in one region, or one place
description: Written by the research agents, read by src/pipeline.py. Files live at research/wines/<wine-id>.json, research/vintages/<region node>/<year>.json and research/places/<region node>.json. Vintage and place files are shared by every wine from there.

id.description: wine: the wine id. vintage: '<region node>/<year>'. place: the region node.

read.description: The date the sources were read.

sources.description: Keyed by a short slug that claims refer to.

about.description: If the page covers another vintage or wine, say which.

source.description: Source slugs, or 'estimate' / 'reading' for reasoning with no outside source.

quote.description: A short excerpt that shows the claim, under 25 words.

vintage.description: Set when the claim is about a different vintage than the subject.

note.description: Why the strength, or what conflicts.

gaps.description: What was looked for and not found.

sheet.description: Vintage and place files: sheet-ready lines a wine may reuse, keyed by field (vintage, soil, ...).

uses.description: Wine files: the shared vintage and place files this wine draws on, as paths under research/ without .json.
